title: FOIA releases of thousands of UFO pages

tellings.quote: And then suddenly, thousands of pages of military failed interceptions and CIA memos and FBI investigations.

plain: From the 1970s into the early 1980s, requests under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, pried loose thousands of pages on UFOs. The UFO historian Richard Dolan says on the show that "suddenly" there were "thousands of pages of military failed interceptions and CIA memos and FBI investigations." If so, it would show the government had been tracking and chasing UFOs far more than it had admitted.
